subject: Surge phase presentation
defect: Calm Building and Fading weather stills remain difficult to distinguish while Break reads mainly through darker lighting and heavier rain
notes: Two unobstructed fixed stands support the still-frame distinction gap; Crown Arch stand is blocked and excluded. Capture timed lightning and motion before judging flash rhythm wind response or afterglow.

subject: creature collapse and rest
defect: Several fainted bodies remain upright or float above the grass and some resting poses do not settle onto the ground
notes: The direct pose fixture needs confirmation in a real faint/rest transition; explicit hovering is visible in Trailpup and Veridian. Cloudreach resting Cloudfang Solmane and Tempestwing show clear ground separation in stills; flying faint states may have different gameplay rules.

subject: creature hurt and movement poses
defect: Hurt and moving frames often retain the idle silhouette so the state is difficult to read without a filename
notes: Still frames cannot establish locomotion timing; check production transition captures before scheduling animation work. Tidewake and Stormwood stills confirm the recurring state-read gap; judge motion before assigning animation timing.

subject: Stormheart finale
defect: The Stormheart finale reads as a dark cylindrical ring with a hole rather than a giant living tree with a branching crown and visible core
notes: Daytime frames support the silhouette defect; dynamo-core approach is obstructed and excluded.

subject: named wild fight actor spacing
defect: Voltarach and Sparkit crowd into the same space so the boss legs mask or intersect the ally and sometimes the trainer
notes: Both named wild fights show the spacing problem across tell, strike and recovery frames. Code-blind review. The longer 65-second Hollows fight repeats the overlap at the first and fourth tell; danger and impact cues remain recognizable. The level-80 winning run repeats this spacing in late combat; the win panel partially hides the collapsed Voltarach.

subject: map
defect: The map canvas shows headings and markers without visible terrain or road context for the displayed destinations
notes: First Shore is marked discovered but the Day 1 state may hide survey detail; both biome maps lack terrain/route context at this state.

subject: normal creature scale
defect: Several normal creatures read visibly shorter than the trainer in the shared near-framed scale view
notes: Apparent visual height varies with perspective and posture; compare with declared size and a level camera before adjusting assets. Stormwood near-framed size comparison confirms this in five additional species. Cloudreach smaller species remain below trainer size in the common stage; exact authored scale versus perspective needs verification.

subject: shiny creature finish
defect: Several shiny variants become near-uniform hot magenta and lose their ordinary species material and pattern identity
notes: Variants are easy to identify; Ripplet and Mosshell retain more form detail.

subject: ground pickup identity
defect: Many unrelated ground pickups share small glowing plants, orbs or generic crates, so their item identity is difficult to read at normal camera distance
notes: Code-blind ground-level review across four biomes. Meadows candies/potions are small colored glows; Tidewake repeats a crate family; Cloudreach potion/revive can read as flowers and five item shots remain unisolated pending targeted reshoot. All 17 chapter-gated ordinary Stormwood pickups were reshot with in-memory flags: potions/tonics share luminous plants, orb tiers/TMs share spheres, and boots/leggings look like tiny glowing tokens rather than gear. Three Stormwood story rewards are event grants, not world pickups.

subject: named wild danger and opening cues
defect: The bright magenta danger slab remains visible through impact while the HUD announces an opening, giving simultaneous danger and punish signals
notes: The conflict is clearest in impact frames; motion and audio were not reviewed.

subject: named destination identities
defect: Several named destinations read as similar grass and trees without a distinct subject in the captured close views
notes: Generic camera stands may miss authored subjects; confirm with targeted route approaches before assigning each landmark.

subject: forest ground and distance layers
defect: Uniform grass and flower carpet across broad flat land weakens the deep wet ancient forest silhouette and distance layers
notes: Representative views across three named regions; night rain alone does not establish reflective pools or layered roots in these frames.

subject: named trainer dialogue identity
defect: Every captured named trainer conversation repeats the same generic line and shows no portrait
notes: All 26 named trainers repeat one generic pre-fight line with no portrait; all 26 post-win text fixtures likewise repeat one generic line with no portrait. Text legible throughout. Post-win fixture does not verify victory or world defeat state.

subject: catch camera distance
defect: Catch framing crowds the trainer and both creatures during aim then jumps close enough at strike and breakout to crop bodies and lose the orb path
notes: Code-blind review of complete dry First Shore wild catch sequence. Cannonback, Terrapup and trainer overlap at aim distance; impact circle dominates Cannonback. The catch failure and success states are genuine pinned rolls, but a second same-species body may be in the scene. Stormwood Voltwig/Terrapup capture repeats the tight overlap and cropped strike; the dark ground makes the chance text more legible than Tidewake. Cloudreach repeats this with trainer across Skyrill face, a second body behind, then tight overhead contact. Code-blind review.

subject: Fly carrier grip pose
defect: The trainer hangs rigidly upright beneath Galecrest with raised straight arms and dangling legs, so the bird reads as perched on the hands rather than carrying a person
notes: Code-blind comparison across three production-camera flight sequences. Meadows launch was reshot with a settled camera and clearly repeats the pose. The carrier silhouette is strong, but the body hold is unconvincing. Stormwood disclosed canopy fixture repeats the same hold; it does not establish campaign reachability.

subject: menu shell
defect: The full-screen charcoal menu with thin teal borders has little visual hierarchy or scenic connection to the illustrated world
notes: Same full-screen shell in Meadows and Tidewake production UI; assess Cloudreach and Stormwood before final shared exposure.

subject: secondary menu panels
defect: The Quests Build and Players panels leave most of their area empty around a few plain text lines or a single button
notes: The Day 1 fixture may explain empty panels, but the screen leaves large dead areas. Skills capture still resembles Quests; verify navigation.

subject: named character silhouettes
defect: Many distinct named roles in Tidewake and Stormwood repeat the same face body and outfit silhouettes
notes: Distinct named roles share world-model and portrait archetypes, corroborated in Tidewake post-win text frames. Recurring same-character appearances excluded. No definite portrait/model mismatch claimed. Meadows captains share eyepatch or bearded armor looks; two patrol conversations use the organization label. Meadows post-win frames confirm repeated black-uniform trainer body looks across distinct named roles.

subject: shared fight tell and hit effects
defect: Tells and openings rely heavily on text while flat magenta floor marks and bright impact effects obscure creature poses and give weak hit-response silhouettes
notes: Meadows and Tidewake code-blind fight review: flat magenta tell ring lacks clear attack path, and Tidewake hit contact barely changes enemy pose. Shared effect family scored once at widest exposure; exact implementation reuse to confirm in 2c. Nerissa repeats the shared tell and weak hit-response pattern; distinct stagger arrow is more legible. Stormwood wild boss frames repeat the weak hit and recovery read with gold bursts over the face.

subject: craft recipe text
defect: Long recipe names and material preview lines are clipped in the crafting list
notes: Ironwood Haft and Wood/Stone preview strings are cut off at 1920x1080; direct-open CraftPanel visual fixture. Cloudreach visual-only fixture repeats this presentation. Stormwood code-blind system view repeats this issue.
